description: Capability for the quick launcher overlay (development-plan.md section 28). Core only: the launcher filters routines, launches them, adds a task and asks the main window for a focus session, all through this app's own commands, which are not permission-gated, and needs `core:event` for `launcher://shown` and the cross-window broadcasts. It is not granted the window permissions its own show/hide/resize would need — those are Rust commands, so a search box can never be the thing that decides where an always-on-top window goes.
